Demonstrated consequence: 305 (extension room) vs 225 (base cap, base definition) vs 200 (base cap, replaced_by anchor). Affected: `advance_ext_largest_advance.overwrite`; scored amount at step 12. Relation to previous revisions: first round.
2. **SOURCE-FACTOR RED** — symptom: both computations declare their only `method` factor on a multiplier substitution. Root cause: `_difficulty.md` §findings F-FAC-1. Evidence: `rounded_relief` = RND(unrounded × m) m∈{1.4,1.2,1}; `adjusted_room` = room × m m∈{1.10,1.05,1}. Demonstrated consequence: honest method count 0 < 1 in both computations. Affected: `factors[card_multiplier].effect`, `factors[card_uplift].effect`. First round.
3. Observation: F-OBS-3 exposure (literal period-13 late fee of 1.00 on the repaid June advance), judged not defensible; GT books no such fee.
